Project Overview

Designed with purpose,
made for everyday life

A royal estate for your palatial abode. An estate that radiates luxury and becomes a statement of your stature for others. Oscar Palace is conceived to transform residential living into a royal experience. Unique location, palace-like entrance, multiple themed gardens, baradaris and walkways, wide internal roads with palace inspired installations, and fort like boundary wall, it is an oasis of luxury.

In the tradition of other Oscar developments, the master planning of Oscar Palace is driven by the thought of making everyday living a royal experience.
